summary.intent: Execute Phase 20 (vault-migration) end-to-end: implement vault blob v2 binary format across core, API, Rust desktop, and web client with lazy migration for existing users.
summary.outcome: All 4 plans executed and verified (6/6 VAULT requirements passed), PR #344 shipped. Scope change documented as a gap: since the staging DB was nuked in phase 19.2 and all vaults are already v2, migration code should be removed in phase 20.1.

repo: orval v7.18.0 generates `{ [key: string]: unknown } | null` instead of `string | null` for nullable string fields even when OpenAPI spec is correct — `as unknown as string` casts are the intentional workaround
NestJS does not auto-log incoming request routes, so POST /vault/migrate appeared to never be called when it actually succeeded silently
The staging database was nuked in phase 19.2 (datastore migration), making all vault migration code dead weight since there are zero non-migrated users
IPFS gateway at port 8080 exposes `/ipns/{name}` path that resolves IPNS AND fetches content in one request with `Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *` — no separate IPNS resolution step needed
Kubo IPFS API at port 5001 resolves IPNS correctly server-side but returns no CORS headers, blocking direct browser requests
Delegated routing API returns CBOR-wrapped records, not raw protobuf — attempting to parse as protobuf returns garbage CIDs
IPNS records for subfolders are only in the CipherBox API DB cache, not propagated to the public DHT — subfolder recovery is blocked without API access
API branch coverage threshold is 77%; new nullable migration fields dropped vault.service.ts to 72% and failed CI

code.finding: fetchAndDecryptMetadata blindly JSON.parses IPFS blob data — crashes with SyntaxError on v2 binary blobs. Fix: detect v2 header and deserialize before JSON parsing.
serialize_vault_blob_v2 had no key length bounds check — u16 would silently truncate keys > 65535 bytes. Changed return type to Result<Vec<u8>, VaultBlobError> with explicit length validation.
#[derive(Debug)] on InitVaultRequest and VaultResponse was leaking encrypted key material in logs. Replaced with custom Debug impls that redact sensitive fields.

Migration PATH A called deriveVaultIpnsKeypair() twice with identical inputs. Hoisted derivation above try/catch. Also found redundant destructure/re-wrap of ipnsKeypair into identical rootIpnsKeypair object.
Desktop vault init was ECIES-wrapping rootFolderKey twice with the same public key — once for DB, once for v2 blob. Fixed to reuse first wrap.
fetchFromIpfs returned undefined on non-404 gateway errors (e.g. 502/503), then detectBlobVersion(undefined) crashed on .length. Added explicit error throw when all gateways fail without 404.
getVault test assertion was missing migratedAt field after toVaultResponse was updated to include it. Also needed 6 new tests to cover nullable migration branch paths to pass 77% threshold.

workflow: When a user's database is reset between phases, always check whether migration/compatibility code has any remaining consumers before investing in it
GSD gap closure workflow (update VERIFICATION.md with gaps_found → plan-phase --gaps → execute) provides clean audit trail for mid-phase scope changes
Spot-checking SUMMARY.md existence + git log for phase-plan commits is a reliable proxy for agent completion when the orchestrator doesn't receive a completion signal
Playwright browser automation is valuable for testing auth flows that require live OTPs — can retrieve OTPs from server logs and extract in-memory keys via page.evaluate()
Pre-wave dependency check (gsd-tools verify key-links) catches cross-plan wiring gaps before spawning dependent agents

friction: orval v7.18.0 codegen bug: `nullable: true` on string fields generates wrong TypeScript type regardless of correct OpenAPI spec — required `as unknown as string` casts and confusing Copilot review comment
Kubo IPFS API lacks CORS headers, making direct browser-to-Kubo communication impossible and requiring multiple fallback approaches in the recovery tool
IPNS records for subfolders not propagated to public DHT — recovery tool subfolder traversal hung indefinitely with no clear error
NestJS silent request logging made the successful /vault/migrate call appear as a failure, requiring database query to confirm the migration actually ran
API test coverage threshold failure required adding 6 new tests after CI caught the regression — coverage check wasn't run locally before push
Merge conflicts in ROADMAP.md and STATE.md from merging main required manual resolution
open_items: Phase 20.1 gap closure: Remove all migration code (PATH B in useAuth.ts, POST /vault/migrate endpoint, nullable crypto DB columns, Rust ECIES key wrapping) — staging DB was nuked so zero non-migrated users exist
Phase 23: Rust SDK Extraction — create shared cipherbox-core crate mirroring @cipherbox/core and @cipherbox/sdk-core, reuse in FUSE code, enable unit testing at same granularity as TypeScript
